security_audit.summary: Most weak cryptography, obfuscation, and markdown command findings are false positives caused by French prose, documentation, or sanitizer patterns. Confirmed risks remain: the skill executes local CLIs and wrappers, reads API keys from environment variables, makes outbound network calls, and writes cache or audit files. No prompt injection text was found in the skill files.

remediation.issue: External command execution through CLIs, wrappers, and custom backend configuration.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict commands to an explicit allowlist, require user confirmation for wrappers, and document exactly which CLIs run.

remediation.issue: API key handling appears in code, shell wrappers, and troubleshooting guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Remove guidance that prints API key fragments, avoid displaying masked keys, and prefer environment-only credential storage.

remediation.issue: Audit trails and cache files can persist source text and model responses.
remediation.suggestion: Make persistence opt-in for sensitive workflows, add redaction controls, and document retention and deletion steps.

remediation.issue: User-supplied URLs are fetched and converted into model prompts.
remediation.suggestion: Validate URL schemes and hosts, block local network targets by default, and warn about remote prompt injection.

remediation.issue: Custom CLI backends inherit the process environment.
remediation.suggestion: Pass a minimal environment to child processes and require explicit opt-in for each secret needed by a backend.

content.value_statement: Long documents are hard to summarize without losing nuance. This skill compares Claude, Gemini, and Codex outputs to produce traceable summaries.
actual_capabilities: Runs Claude, Gemini, and Codex in separate expert roles.
Produces summaries from text, local files, PDFs, DOCX files, or URLs.
Calculates convergence scores across model outputs.
Checks summaries for semantic drift, omissions, and disagreement.
Writes optional audit trails and Markdown summary files.
Supports fast, standard, critical, pedagogic, and direct modes.
limitations: Requires configured CLIs or API credentials before model calls work.
May send source content to external model providers.
Audit trails and cache files can persist sensitive source text locally.
Most documentation and prompts are written in French.

use_cases.title: Prepare Executive Briefs
use_cases.description: Turn long reports into framed summaries with noted disagreements and traceable source references.

use_cases.title: Review Research Materials
use_cases.description: Compare several sources and identify consensus, gaps, and semantic shifts before writing a literature brief.

use_cases.title: Validate Existing Summaries
use_cases.description: Use critical mode to check whether a summary changed the meaning of the source text.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Document
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a basic council summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Synthese Multi-LLM to summarize this document for a general reader in 10 lines. Highlight any disagreement between models.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Decision Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with audience and purpose.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the council to summarize this report for an executive committee. Focus on risks, decisions, and open questions.

prompt_templates.title: Check Semantic Drift
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an existing summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run critical mode on this source and my draft summary. Identify omissions, overstatements, and changed meanings.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Multiple Sources
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these sources with references enabled. Separate consensus, contradictions, and evidence gaps for a research brief.

output_examples.input: A policy report about artificial intelligence regulation for a public-sector team.
output: The result starts with a concise summary for the requested audience.
It separates confirmed facts, model disagreements, and policy implications.
It includes a convergence score and notes where source support is weak.

output_examples.input: An existing summary that may overstate the source document.
output: The result lists meaning changes, missing qualifications, and unsupported claims.
It recommends corrected wording that stays closer to the source.
It marks unresolved disagreements for human review.

output_examples.input: Several articles about the same market trend.
output: The result groups shared points, conflicting claims, and unique evidence by source.
It gives a final synthesis with clear caveats and practical next steps.

best_practices: Set the audience, purpose, length, tone, and expertise level before running the council.
Disable trails or redact sources when handling confidential material.
Review low-convergence results manually before using them in decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not send regulated or confidential data to external models without approval.
Do not treat convergence scores as proof that the summary is correct.
Do not store API keys in project configuration files that may be committed.

faq.question: Which tools does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code, and it can also call Gemini through its CLI.

faq.question: Does it require API keys?
faq.answer: It can use authenticated CLIs. The Anthropic backend and Claude wrapper require ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

faq.question: Can it summarize files and URLs?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes loaders for text files, PDFs, DOCX files, direct text, and web URLs.

faq.question: What is the audit trail?
faq.answer: The audit trail records session inputs, model responses, convergence data, and the final summary in local files.

faq.question: Is it safe for confidential documents?
faq.answer: Use caution. It can call external models and can persist source text in cache or trail files.

faq.question: What does critical mode do?
faq.answer: Critical mode focuses on omissions, semantic drift, bias, and disagreements between summaries and source material.
